description: Simplified operation/tool/feature vocabulary for the SCMPA MVP. Pedagogical rule set, not an industrial standard.
assumptions: Tool compatibility is decided by tool type only; tool diameter, length, flute count and wear are not modelled.

Each feature type lists the operation types considered suitable to contribute to it. If a feature declares required_operation_types, all of them must be applied; otherwise any one suitable operation is treated as covering it.
Face milling is mapped only to face mills for clarity, although end mills can face small areas in practice. This is a deliberate simplification of the demo rule set.
No operation order is encoded here. Ordering assumptions are component-specific and live in each component's precedence_constraints.
